observationSource: Aster G. Taylor, Ann Arbor, 2025-08-07 EDT, original wide-angle Unihedron SQM, zenith
primarySubsetRule: geometric topocentric solar-center altitude > -6 deg, frozen before MYSTIC residuals
instrumentRangeSubmetricRule: observed SQM >= 7 mag/arcsec2, based only on Unihedron published approximate bright-end range; not used to alter the 25-row primary universe

atmosphere.aeronetResult: no qualifying V3 Level-2 rows at Windsor_B or Windsor_M under <=75 km and +/-3 h rule
atmosphere.surfacePressureSource: KARB ASOS, linear interpolation/extrapolation between 00:53 UTC 1019.9 hPa and 01:53 UTC 1020.4 hPa

sqmForwardOperator.radialQuadrature: Gauss-Legendre in mu=cos(theta), order 8 over theta=0..65 deg
sqmForwardOperator.spectralResponse: engineering digitization of published combined SQM response; CM-500 manufacturer transmission used for incidence-angle correction
sqmForwardOperator.zeroPoint: Vega synthetic magnitude using CALSPEC alpha_lyr_stis_011.fits

uncertaintyContract.mcSpectralCovarianceTreatment: within each ray sum spectral standard deviations linearly; combine independent ray terms in quadrature

analysisContract.classificationRule: ABSOLUTE_CONSISTENT if abs(bias_z)<=2 and covariance_reduced_chi2<=2; SHAPE_CONSISTENT diagnostic if shape_reduced_chi2<=2; otherwise corresponding inconsistency label

freshSeedScheme.collisionSearch: no repository matches for 941001/941002/taylor-ann-arbor-sqm-mystic-v1 before freeze
